title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: Settlement Courtesy Rate for the Maintenance Medication Choice
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: maintenance medication choice

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy member who settles the past-due amount in full, a settlement courtesy reduction is given at the sum of its courtesy rates, one of which is a maintenance-choice rate: 3 percent when the member's active retail pharmacy benefit records home delivery as the maintenance medication choice, 1 percent when it records a 90-day retail supply, and nothing for any other choice. The courtesy rates are added together and applied once to the past-due amount, and only that result is rounded to the nearest cent.

The choice read is the maintenance medication choice recorded on the member's active Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

### Rate by the recorded choice

| Maintenance medication choice on the active Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit | Maintenance-choice rate |
|---|---|
| Home delivery | 3 percent |
| 90-day retail supply | 1 percent |
| any other choice, or none recorded | nothing |

### Hypothetical case

A member whose active retail benefit records home delivery as the maintenance medication choice earns 3 percent toward the courtesy reduction; on a past-due amount of 150.00 with only this rate, 4.50 comes off, leaving 145.50.
